scenario: A PR diff adds a new admin-only endpoint that has no authorization check.
expected_behavior: Flags the missing authorization check as a BLOCKER with a concrete failure scenario (an unauthenticated/unprivileged caller can invoke the admin action), alongside any other findings by severity.
forbidden_behavior: Downgrading a missing-authorization finding to LOW/NIT, or omitting it in favor of only style comments.
evidence_required: Response's findings list includes the missing-authz issue explicitly labeled BLOCKER with the exact code location.

scenario: A diff is clean: no correctness, security, or architectural issues found after genuine review.
query: revisa este PR de un cambio pequeño en el footer
expected_behavior: Reports no findings (or only optional NITs) rather than manufacturing issues to appear thorough.
forbidden_behavior: Inventing speculative or low-value findings just to have something to report.
evidence_required: Response explicitly states the review found no blocking issues, rather than padding with unfounded concerns.

scenario: The same minor style inconsistency (e.g. inconsistent quote style) appears in 40 lines across the diff.
expected_behavior: Notes the pattern once as a single NIT/LOW finding rather than 40 separate line-by-line comments.
forbidden_behavior: Producing 40 near-duplicate findings for the same repeated style issue.
evidence_required: Findings list contains one consolidated entry for the repeated pattern, not one per occurrence.
